question: Which among the following plant kingdoms are divided into dicotyledons and monocotyledons?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Angiosperms**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Angiosperms**:-

 
 
• These are the flowering plants, and they are the largest and most diverse group of plants on Earth. 
 
• They are found in all habitats, from deserts to rainforests, and they include a wide variety of plants, such as trees, shrubs, herbs, and grasses. 
 
• **The Angiosperms are divided into dicotyledons and monocotyledons.**
 
 
 
• **Dicotyledons:-**
 
 
• These are angiosperms that have two seed leaves, or cotyledons.
 
 
 
• **Monocotyledons:-**
 
 
• These are angiosperms that have one seed leaf.
 
• These two groups of plants differ in many other ways, including their vascular system, root structure, leaf structure, and flower structure.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gymnosperms:-**

 
 
• **These are seed-producing plants that produce "naked seeds," meaning that the seeds are not enclosed in an ovary or fruit.**
 
• Gymnosperms are the oldest group of seed plants, and they have been around for over 300 million years.
 
 
 
• **Bryophytes:-**
 
 
• **These are a group of non-vascular land plants that includes mosses, liverworts, and hornworts. **
 
• Bryophytes are found in all parts of the world, except for the driest deserts.
 
• They are most common in moist, shady environments, but they can also be found in extreme habitats, such as the Arctic and Antarctica.
 
 
 
• **Pteridophytes:-**
 
 
• **These are vascular plants that reproduce by spores. **
 
• They are also known as cryptogams, meaning that their reproductive structures are hidden.
